entry.p: While your vehicle is stopped, and if Safe Exit Warning detects a vehicle approaching the rear corner of your vehicle and a passenger opens a door, Safe Exit Warning may warn you with a warning message and a warning sound to help avoid a collision.

note.p: Warning timing may vary depending on the speed of the approaching vehicle.

section.title: Detecting sensor
section.p: Safe Exit Warning uses the rear corner radar. Please refer to for the sensor locations.

note.p: For more details on the precautions of the rear corner radars, refer to .
